ucs.title: [LLM] Conti / Wizard Spider pre-encryption defense-impairment chain (vssadmin + wmic + bcdedit + wbadmin within 10 min)
ucs.description: Hunts the textbook pre-encryption sequence from the leaked Conti operator playbook: deleting Volume Shadow Copies with vssadmin AND wmic, then crippling Windows Recovery via bcdedit, then wiping the backup catalog with wbadmin — all within minutes on the same host. Two or more of these tools firing within a 10-minute window on a single endpoint is a near-deterministic Conti / Wizard Spider (G0102) / FIN12 indicator that precedes encryption.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process_name) as tools values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents dc(Processes.process_name) as distinct_tools from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where ( (Processes.process_name=vssadmin.exe AND Processes.process="*delete*shadows*" AND Processes.process="*/all*") OR (Processes.process_name=wmic.exe AND Processes.process="*shadowcopy*delete*") OR (Processes.process_name=bcdedit.exe AND (Processes.process="*bootstatuspolicy*ignoreallfailures*" OR Processes.process="*recoveryenabled*no*")) OR (Processes.process_name=wbadmin.exe AND Processes.process="*delete*catalog*") ) by host Processes.user Processes.dest _time span=10m | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where distinct_tools >= 2 | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
ucs.kql:
let WindowMinutes = 10m;
let ContiPlaybookCmds = DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("delete","shadows") and ProcessCommandLine has "/all")
     or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("shadowcopy","delete"))
     or (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and (ProcessCommandLine has "bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures" or ProcessCommandLine has "recoveryenabled no"))
     or (FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("delete","catalog"))
| extend Bucket = bin(Timestamp, WindowMinutes);
ContiPlaybookCmds
| summarize FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
            DistinctTools = dcount(FileName),
            Tools = make_set(FileName),
            CmdLines = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 25),
            Parents = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName)
            by DeviceName, AccountName, Bucket
| where DistinctTools >= 2
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let WindowMinutes = 10m;
let ContiPlaybookCmds = SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where AccountType == "User" and Account !endswith "$"
| where (NewProcessName endswith "\\vssadmin.exe" and CommandLine has_all ("delete","shadows") and CommandLine has "/all")
     or (NewProcessName endswith "\\wmic.exe" and CommandLine has_all ("shadowcopy","delete"))
     or (NewProcessName endswith "\\bcdedit.exe" and (CommandLine has "bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures" or CommandLine has "recoveryenabled no"))
     or (NewProcessName endswith "\\wbadmin.exe" and CommandLine has_all ("delete","catalog"))
| extend Bucket = bin(TimeGenerated, WindowMinutes);
ContiPlaybookCmds
| summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
            DistinctTools = dcount(NewProcessName),
            Tools = make_set(NewProcessName),
            CmdLines = make_set(CommandLine, 25),
            Parents = make_set(ParentProcessName)
            by Computer, Account, Bucket
| where DistinctTools >= 2
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 ( (@Image:(*\\vssadmin.exe OR *\\VSSAdmin.exe OR *\\VSSADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*delete*shadows* OR *Delete*Shadows*) AND @CommandLine:*/all*) OR (@Image:(*\\wmic.exe OR *\\WMIC.exe OR *\\WMIC.EXE) AND @CommandLine:*shadowcopy* AND @CommandLine:*delete*) OR (@Image:(*\\bcdedit.exe OR *\\BCDEdit.exe OR *\\BCDEDIT.EXE) AND (@CommandLine:*bootstatuspolicy*ignoreallfailures* OR @CommandLine:*recoveryenabled*no*)) OR (@Image:(*\\wbadmin.exe OR *\\WBAdmin.exe OR *\\WBADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:*delete*catalog*) )
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (ImageFileName=/\\vssadmin\.exe$/i CommandLine=/delete\s+shadows/i CommandLine=/\/all/i) OR (ImageFileName=/\\wmic\.exe$/i CommandLine=/shadowcopy.*delete/i) OR (ImageFileName=/\\bcdedit\.exe$/i CommandLine=/(bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures|recoveryenabled\s+no)/i) OR (ImageFileName=/\\wbadmin\.exe$/i CommandLine=/delete\s+catalog/i)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName], function=[count(field=ImageFileName, distinct=true, as=DistinctTools), min(_time, as=FirstSeen), max(_time, as=LastSeen), collect([ImageFileName, CommandLine])])
| DistinctTools >= 2
ucs.rationale: This exact 4-tool combination — vssadmin + wmic shadowcopy + bcdedit (both flags) + wbadmin delete catalog — was published verbatim in the August 2021 Conti operator manual leak and was reused in essentially every Conti/Ryuk/BazarLoader engagement DFIR Report and Mandiant tracked through 2022, plus the FIN12 follow-on intrusions. Legitimate admins rarely run two of these tools in a 10-min window;

ucs.title: [LLM] Conti / Wizard Spider AdFind AD enumeration with operator-playbook output filenames (ad_users.txt / trustdmp / dclist)
ucs.description: Hunts adfind.exe invocations that write to the exact output filenames hard-coded in the leaked Conti playbook (ad_users.txt, ad_computers.txt, ad_group.txt, ad_ous.txt, trustdmp.txt, dclist.txt, subnets.txt) — the post-Cobalt-Strike AD reconnaissance step Wizard Spider operators perform before lateral movement and DC compromise. Filenames double as a renamed-binary catch (adfind copied as r.exe still writes ad_users.txt).
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent values(Processes.process_name) as binary from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name=adfind.exe OR Processes.process="*adfind*") AND (Processes.process="*ad_users.txt*" OR Processes.process="*ad_computers.txt*" OR Processes.process="*ad_group.txt*" OR Processes.process="*ad_ous.txt*" OR Processes.process="*trustdmp*" OR Processes.process="*dclist*" OR Processes.process="*subnets.txt*" OR Processes.process="*-sc trustdmp*" OR Processes.process="*-sc dclist*") by host Processes.user Processes.dest | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where FileName =~ "adfind.exe"
    or ProcessCommandLine has "adfind"
    or InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "adfind.exe"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (
    "ad_users.txt","ad_computers.txt","ad_group.txt","ad_ous.txt",
    "trustdmp","dclist","subnets.txt","-sc trustdmp","-sc dclist",
    "-f (objectcategory=person)","-f objectcategory=computer")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, SHA256,
          ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          IsInitiatingProcessRemoteSession
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where AccountType == "User" and Account !endswith "$"
| where NewProcessName endswith "\\adfind.exe"
    or CommandLine has "adfind"
    or ParentProcessName endswith "\\adfind.exe"
| where CommandLine has_any (
    "ad_users.txt","ad_computers.txt","ad_group.txt","ad_ous.txt",
    "trustdmp","dclist","subnets.txt","-sc trustdmp","-sc dclist",
    "-f (objectcategory=person)","-f objectcategory=computer")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account, NewProcessName,
          CommandLine, ParentProcessName, TokenElevationType
| order by TimeGenerated desc

status: experimental
description: Detects AdFind reconnaissance using the exact output filenames documented in the August 2021 Conti operator playbook leak (DFIR Report 2021/05). Highly specific to Wizard Spider / FIN12 / Conti / Ryuk intrusions.
references:
  - https://thedfirreport.com/2021/05/12/conti-ransomware/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0102/
author: SOC detection engineering
date: 2024/01/01
tags:
  - attack.discovery
  - attack.t1087.002
  - attack.t1018
  - attack.t1482
  - attack.g0102
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_binary:
    Image|endswith: '\adfind.exe'
  selection_artifacts:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'ad_users.txt'
      - 'ad_computers.txt'
      - 'ad_group.txt'
      - 'ad_ous.txt'
      - 'trustdmp'
      - 'dclist'
      - 'subnets.txt'
      - '-sc trustdmp'
      - '-sc dclist'
  condition: selection_binary or selection_artifacts
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate AD inventory by enterprise admins using AdFind (rare, normally Sharphound/PingCastle replaces this)
level: high

#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 (ImageFileName=/\\adfind\.exe$/i OR CommandLine=/adfind/i)
| regex("(ad_users\.txt|ad_computers\.txt|ad_group\.txt|ad_ous\.txt|trustdmp|dclist|subnets\.txt|-sc\s+trustdmp|-sc\s+dclist)", field=CommandLine)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, ParentBaseFileName, CommandLine], function=[count(as=Hits), min(_time, as=FirstSeen)])
